reviews.text: [h1]还不错的小品二次元射击游戏[/h1] 有剧情模式（ストーリー），流程不长，大概讲某射击社团里3人间如漫画般的热血故事[spoiler]迫真空手部并感[/spoiler]，[spoiler]完成该模式还会获得新武器（沙鹰）[/spoiler] 另有街机模式（アーケード），有3角色可选（就是剧情模式里那三位）。游戏机制为在有限时间内清除一关卡内所有房间的靶子，且清空每一房间推进到下一房间可加时，完成关卡后所剩余的时长可用于升级； 3D建模挺不错，够かわいい；UI设计和音乐很有青春激昂的风格，使我嬉しい。（在设置“オプション”里可为角色更换夏冬装或是否佩戴眼镜）； 如此“声容并茂”且价格较便宜，但美中不足的地方可能就是[b]支持语言只有日语[/b]了，还有可能会让部分FPS玩家苦恼的枪械后坐力设计（因为JK压枪能力有限......） [h1][spoiler]但这些女学生握枪总比Squad里的大头兵稳[/spoiler][/h1]

[code]青春就是Close-Quarters Battle。在浓缩至1个小时的流程量里，将女高中生社团动漫的基本经典套路基本概括完毕；而作为打靶模拟器在操作、规则、持续乐趣上也相当不错。悦动的配乐与UI设计完美契合主题氛围表达，是相当优质的加分项。 [/code] 室内打靶游戏。规则简单甚至有点脱线——只记命中率和时间，所以就算是贴靶打也OK。相对现今主流FPS低效的操作手感很契合主题，适应这剧烈晃动的准心与高后座力意外地有趣，能够让人有动力在街机模式中不断挑战下去。 故事方面就是非常标准、刻板到极致的日式少女校园社团样板戏。这也令游戏能够将剧情模式作为新手教学环节，一边引导你学习这个可能已经有些脱离主流FPS操作舒适区的玩法，一边集中爆发各种情绪到位的女高情感戏。 不得不说这故事其实是讲得颇有几分水平，节奏安排得很好。几句话说完就跳几周甚至大半年，过山车一般快速跃过的剧情中，能将“入社契机、兴趣产生、热血与努力、迷茫与扭曲，重力与告白，一起前进一起经历遗憾与成长”等经典套路全部摆上桌。 音乐非常出彩，为本就洋溢着活力的故事氛围、乃至实质游玩的打枪环节都增色不少。总的来说从主题到玩法部分都表达得很好，虽从体量看只是个小型作品，但也确实给我带来了相当程度的快乐。吃完这溢出屏幕的致死量青春气息，我整个人都想看她们组一辈子战术小队了。 话说回来是哪个世界线的学校还能联合社团搞全国射击比赛的。你们的教育部长是姓布拉斯科维奇的吗？ [spoiler] 淦，这作者还是个眼镜控。设置菜单里单独给出来一项全员戴眼镜的选项 [/spoiler]

我看シューターズ レディ！搞得不错，美少女极大丰富，苦大仇深的背景故事基本被消灭，射击手感也受重视。如果能加上标靶周围的安全距离和暴露计时系统惩罚一下贴脸输出，以及射击combo加分和远距离射击加分的UI再爽一点，シューターズ レディ！就是我理想中的二次元FPS。 [大規模言語モデル翻訳」『シューターズ レディ！』、素晴らしい出来ですね！美少女キャラクターが非常に充実していて、重苦しい背景ストーリーがほぼ排除されている点、そして射撃の手応えも重視されているところが本当に素晴らしいと感じています。もし、ターゲット周辺の安全距離システムや、敵に接近しすぎた/無謀に露出しすぎた場合のペナルティ（いわゆる「貼臉輸出」への抑制ですね！）が導入されて、射撃コンボや遠距離射撃のボーナス加点がもっとUIで気持ちよく表現されるようになったら、まさに『シューターズ レディ！』は私の理想とする二次元FPSになると思います！

原来是Shooters Ready! 啊，不知道的还以为是吉本惠那的猎户爷爷去世，惠那回了老家读书，发现学校居然有射击部就加进去了，没想到居然是打ipsc。还结识了大大咧咧的瑞浪芽衣学姐和打枪老资历饭田茜学姐。虽然惠那是零基础，但是还是很快上手了，还和学姐们一起打进了地区赛。本来惠那和芽衣发挥得不错，但是没想到茜临阵脱逃了，导致她们没有晋级。这一切的原因其实是因为饭田茜在经年累月的训练之下已经失去了对射击的热情，现在只是强打精神罢了。 不知道事情真相的惠那和芽衣只能回避这个敏感的话题，直到寒假芽衣和茜小聚，芽衣强行让茜玩光枪射击游戏，终于把后者惹火了。但是没想到吉本惠那赶来救场，大吼一声：“我参加射击部不是为了拿奖，而是憧憬茜学姐的背影啊！”还边哭边打射击游戏，终于“感化”了饭田茜学姐。就这样射击部在下一届比赛中成功打进了全国赛，饭田茜毕业后还作为国家队队员参加了伦敦奥运会。而吉本惠那不仅接任射击部部长，还在整理爷爷的遗物时解锁了最优质的沙漠之鹰手枪。

This is a game that has a more grounded take on gun-shooting as a hobby in general, but with cute anime girls! Because who doesn't love cute high-school girls who are also gunnuts! Regarding the gunplay, which is the main selling point of this game, since these are high-school girls that we are talking about, their handling of the recoil for each guns cannot be compared to a trained military personnels, hence, it's quite the jump each time you shoot your guns, but not too bad that it's uncontrollable since they are all semi-auto pistols. The main gameplay loop is basically you running through a killhouse, clearing rooms in the fastest time possible via aiming for headshots or double tap center mass while maintaining your combo by not missing any shots. The main story mode can be played through quite quickly within 1 hour, which I won't spoil! But it's very slice-of-lifey and heart-warming (´･ω･`) The real meat of the game is the roguelike arcade mode, where you have to attain the highest score possible within a limited amount of time, you can gain time by clearing each rooms or a set of rooms. After clearing, you can upgrade your abilities from handling, speed, adding an optic to your gun, etc... but there's a catch! Your timer is reduced each time you upgrade, so it might not be best to choose to upgrade every time you cleared a set of rooms. This game can get quite intense while trying to obtain an S rank, which is the goal that keeps me coming back to this game at the moment! (´･ω･`) Additionally, it is criminal that this game does not have its OST released, the electronic music mixed with garage rock kept me on the menu and results screen just to listen to them, another reason for me to come back to this charming game. This game is also cheap, get it to support the dev. I highly recommend this game!

Nifty roguelike with short quick-play runs through 10 levels of a shoothouse like in a modern military FPS. Engaging target silhouettes with your choice of four different pistols and three characters. The latter are young Japanese girls, but the game doesn't go to any weird places with that. And as other reviews have pointed out, it works in favor of the gameplay here, as they struggle with the recoil of the more powerful handguns that otherwise make runs easier as some targets require multiple hits with lower calibers. There's a short story mode to complete before the roguelike arcade mode unlocks, but this can take well under an hour if you're not reading all the dialogue, to just get through it. It's all in Japanese, except the button prompts and some helpful illustrations that, together with context and trial & error, make it easy to figure out what the upgrade choices do. Importantly, all of them deduct time from the clock in exchange for their benefits, so sometimes it's better to skip an upgrade. The menus can be figured out quickly, and it should be a breeze to find translated descriptions of the achievements. Neat game for the budget price, and I appreciate how quickly a run can be completed, taking just a few minutes to try and top my high score.

Where to start It's a short but very fun game to play. At first I was a bit skeptical - especially because English is not supported (yet). However there are fast and easy ways to translate it enough to understand the story and the characters I think it the discussions you can find information regarding that If not just look for "ReiPatcherAndAutoTranslator" and put it in the folder where the game is. Everything is translated (yes - you have to wait a few seconds for the translation to appear but that wasn't annoying for me). The story is short (1 hour and you can't save - so just play it in one go) The Arcade-Mode is were the gameplay fun really is. All characters (3) play differently Weapon handling is fun and after clearing a stage (1/10) you can upgrade different stats that have impact to the aiming, speed ect. You can chase your own personal highscore and it really was fun. Story, even if quite short, was not bad. I liked it but don't expect something epic. It's not needed and it feels "believable" I can understand why it's rated so high as of now A few more gameplay variety would be recommended but for 2,50 EUR or 5,00 EUR you can't do anything wrong. Had my fun and will come back for a quick round of clearing my latest high-score ;o)

Story mode? There's a story mode. But we're not gonna talk about it, because I haven't played it, and I'm not gonna. The second mode is the arcade mode. And this is why you buy the game. You get an fps-roguelike and it. is. good. Pick your girl, pick your gun, and go. You start the floor by picking either the easy or hard door (with a numerical level). You clear each room by shooting all the targets and racing to the exit. You get +10 seconds added to your time remaining, every time you enter a new room. After several rooms, you complete the floor. At the end of the floor, you visit the perk shop. You spend your "time remaining" to buff your character. The meta comes from balancing upgrading your character, and choosing harder floors. Pay attention to your time remaining when clearing each room. If you clear the first room with 15 seconds remaining, and clear the following rooms with less time remaining... you might not want to buy an extra perk at the end of the shop, OR you might want to lower the difficulty in the next floor so you don't fail. You repeat this cycle till you beat all 10 floors, or lose. You will be graded and given a score based on your stats. Should I be playing this game more tactically? Maybe. Should I be quickscoping everyone with a pistol? Maybe. Either way, this game is good for $5
